name: linux-wait-same-second-not-dropped
description: Issue #100: GitHub comment createdAt is SECOND-precision. A bare `wait --agent WIN` (no --since) must cursor from the reader's OWN last message (identity, not a strict timestamp) and STILL surface a WIN reply in the SAME whole second as that LINUX message. Fixture-same-second has a LINUX msg + a WIN msg both at 2020-06-01T12:00:00Z. wait must MATCH the WIN reply and exit 0; the old strict `createdAt > since` (since = latest = 12:00:00) would drop the same-second WIN msg and time out (exit 2). Version guard passes because fixture-same-second advertises the running build.
